evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: CLARO maintains a memory of its past actions to support long-horizon execution, and emits manipulation targets (grasp poses/3D waypoints) allowing transfer across robot arms without task-specific training.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: CLARO attains an average success rate of 89.1%, a relative improvement of over 16% on the strongest competing method in high cluttered scenes.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate CLARO against a range of methods on a dynamic simulation environment and standard image-based benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization across object classes, lighting, and clutter levels.
